Name: Fishing Bar Growth
Author: xixifu
Description:
[b][size=6][center]你钓的鱼越多，钓鱼就越轻松[/center][/size][/b]你是否觉得钓鱼等级达到 10 级后，成长的停滞让人感到遗憾？
在原版游戏中，一旦你的技能升满，钓鱼条（绿条）的长度就会锁死。无论你这辈子钓了 500 条鱼还是 50,000 条鱼，游戏判定都是一样的。

[b]本模组改变了这一点。[/b] 它引入了一个“熟练度”系统，奖励你长期的钓鱼投入。

[b]模组机制[/b]在原版星露谷物语中，绿条的长度仅由你的钓鱼等级决定（0-10级，以及食物Buff）。
[list]
[*][b]原版 0 级：[/b] 96 像素
[*][b]原版 10 级：[/b] 176 像素（每升一级增加 8 像素）
[/list][b]安装本模组后：[/b]我们增加了一个独立的成长进度，该进度基于你的[b]生涯钓鱼总数[/b]（可在统计菜单中查看）。
[list]
[*][b]每钓 10 条鱼 = 绿条增加 1 像素。[/b]
[*][b]每钓 80 条鱼 = 绿条增加 8 像素（相当于增加了 1 级钓鱼等级的条长）。[/b]
[/list]这种增长是[b]独立于[/b]钓鱼等级之外的。即使你已经满级，只要你继续钓鱼，你的绿条就会越来越长。

[b]为什么要使用这个模组？[/b]
这个机制让你的每一次下杆都有意义。哪怕是为了任务钓了 20 条廉价的鲤鱼，它们也不再是浪费时间——它们都在为你将来挑战“传说鱼王”积累实打实的优势。


[b][size=5][center]The More You Fish, The Easier It Gets[/center][/size][/b]Do you feel like hitting Fishing Level 10 is an artificial limit?
In the vanilla game, once you max out your skill, your green bobber bar stops growing. Whether you've caught 500 fish or 50,000 fish, the game treats you exactly the same.

[b]This mod changes that.[/b] It introduces a "Proficiency" system that rewards your long-term dedication.
[b]How It Works[/b]In vanilla Stardew Valley, your fishing bar size is determined solely by your Fishing Level (0-10, plus food buffs).
[list]
[*][b]Vanilla Level 0:[/b] 96 pixels
[*][b]Vanilla Level 10:[/b] 176 pixels (+8 pixels per level)
[/list][b]With Angler's Proficiency:[/b]We add a separate, cumulative growth mechanic based on your [b]Total Fish Caught[/b] (visible in your stats menu).
[list]
[*][b]Every 10 fish caught = +1 Pixel to your bar.[/b]
[*][b]Every 80 fish caught = +8 Pixels (Equivalent to +1 Fishing Level).[/b]
[/list]This growth is [b]independent[/b] of your Fishing Level. Even if you are Level 10, your bar will continue to grow as you catch more fish.

[b]Why use this mod?[/b]
It turns every single catch into progress. Those 20 chubs you caught for a quest? They are no longer a waste of time—they are actively making it easier for you to catch the Legend fish later on.
